in_marathi.name: Sushantraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Peace and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sushantraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sushantra is a compound name derived from Sanskrit words ‘Su’ meaning good and ‘Shantra’ meaning peace or prosperity. The name ‘Sushantraj’ is the regal title for a ruler or king who embodies the qualities of peace and prosperity.
